_doc: Phonetic anagrams (EXACT) — sets of words built from the same multiset of phonemes in different orders (e.g. cats / tacks / scat / acts). Words are stacked by sound: each entry in `sounds` is one distinct phoneme sequence with every spelling of it, and a set is only listed when it holds >=2 sequences (a set where every word sounds alike is a homophone list, not an anagram).
